failed_attempts.reason: fixture attempted ordinary verifier.log creation inside bpffs; EPERM
DROP counter query omitted -t mangle for its new chain
strict firewall baseline comparison failed: new mangle POSTROUTING empty native hook was not primed before baseline

mechanism.program: BPF_PROG_TYPE_SOCKET_FILTER=1, 16 instructions; scope by __sk_buff.ingress_ifindex; compare actual __sk_buff.ifindex with frozen entry; missing/mismatching entry returns 1 to DROP
mechanism.rename: compare actual outgoing ifindex, so an original still alive under another name cannot authorize a different device claiming its old name
mechanism.reuse: kernel NETDEV_UNREGISTER clears original map entry; subsequent index/name/MAC reuse cannot refill the frozen map
mechanism.lifetime: pin map/program, close/reopen owner FDs; retired map remains empty and denies MAP_UPDATE; new generation after removing old rule can authorize current device
mechanism.cleanup: remove exact firewall rules before unlinking pins/closing owners/unmounting private bpffs

limitations: Synthetic veth forwarding, not real Qeli TUN/worker/VPN; production Rust and packaged unit unchanged.
FD close/reopen is not process SIGKILL or journal-based worker recovery.
No established TCP/UDP conntrack, RFC1918 off-WAN exceptions, delegated pools, real firewalld daemon or multiprofile composition in this batch.
Stock systemd privileges cannot run this prototype; runtime bootstrap/installation ownership and supported kernel/capability combinations require implementation.
Prototype raw BPF syscall ABI is intentionally x86_64 only, not a portable production implementation.
No device group mutations, but complete compatibility with all third-party mangle/TC/mark policies is not certified.
Global xt_bpf module autoload occurred once; it is left loaded, not silently described as an unchanged module cache.
No global BPF object inventory baseline or hostile-root protection claimed.
